title: Parity-Reduced Transverse Wronskians, Higher Dipole Invariants, and Rigorous Continuum Certification for Riemann's Xi-Function
proven_theorems: Odd transverse parity W(-d,t) = -W(d,t) with d^{2k}W/dd^{2k}(0,t) = 0 for all k >= 0 (Proposition 2.1)

Division-free Wigner-hyperbolic representation W_tilde(d,t) = W(d,t)/d = (1/2) int_0^infty y^2 sinc_hyp(dy) I(y,t) dy with flat Neumann tangent dW_tilde/dd(0,t) = 0 and W_tilde(0,t) = (Xi'(t))^2 - Xi(t)Xi''(t) (Proposition 2.1)
Higher transverse dipole moment hierarchy c_{2m-1}(t) and pure-square coalescence cascade c_{2m-1}(t_0) = (m/(m!)^2)(Xi^{(m)}(t_0))^2 > 0 (Theorem 3.1)
Division-free Cauchy-Riemann partial derivative identities for W_tilde, dW_tilde/dt, and dW_tilde/dd via sinc_hyp(w) and eta_hyp(w) (Proposition 3.3)

Directed-rounding interval certification (mpmath.iv) of c_1(gamma_k), c_3(gamma_k), c_5(gamma_k) > 0 across gamma_1..gamma_10, 80 2D Interval-MVT collar boxes, 5 macro argument-principle rectangles, and 4,987,101 continuum Lipschitz cells on [0, 0.50] x [0, 55] (Theorem 1.1 & Proposition 4.1)
